'''R4-W9''' was an [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]] with an exceptional map of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] and [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]] of the region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bandin Dobah]] wanted this map and stole the droid and entrusted him to [[Daro Blunt]]. A group of adventurers, on the trail of Dobah, managed to release him. He rewarded them by giving the location of [[Bandin Dobah's asteroid base|Dobah's hideout]].
